features.title: Harness Bootstrap And Spec Lock
features.goal: Initialize cujian scheduler harness artifacts and lock the implementation/test source documents.
acceptance: cujian_scheduler contains app_spec.txt, feature_list.json, claude-progress.txt, init.sh, README.md
Harness includes case catalog, report template, scripts, and config examples
init.sh status reports the next recommended unfinished feature

features.title: Smart Cut Scheduler Data Model
features.goal: Define business-task and edit-history models for Smart Cut scheduling and result tracking.
acceptance: smart_cut_tasks contains stage state, TOS bindings, and final result fields
smart_cut_edits captures preview history and active_edit_id linkage
Model tests cover status transitions and stage ownership
features.owner_notes: Completed. Models in apps/api/app/models.py, domain logic in apps/api/app/smart_cut_domain.py, 28 tests passing.

features.title: Upload Prepare/Complete And TOS Binding
features.goal: Implement task creation, upload-prepare, upload-complete, and secure TOS key binding.
acceptance: upload-prepare returns deterministic input object keys for the task
upload-complete validates key prefix, prepare binding, and object existence
Task cannot enter analyze until upload-complete succeeds
features.owner_notes: Completed. API endpoints: POST /api/smart-cut/tasks, upload-prepare, upload-complete. Fake TOS client implemented. 15 API tests passing.

features.title: Analyze Stage Scheduling
features.goal: Connect smart_cut_analyze to scheduler and move tasks from ready_analyze to waiting_user.
acceptance: Analyze creates a scheduler task instead of running inline
Worker downloads input from TOS and writes script plus asr artifacts
Analyze success releases the worker and advances business task state
features.owner_notes: Completed. API: POST /api/smart-cut/tasks/{id}/analyze, Worker callbacks: analyze-complete/fail. State: ready_analyze -> analyzing -> waiting_user/failed.

features.title: Preview Stage Scheduling And Edit History
features.goal: Add preview scheduling, edit history, active edit selection, and audio_b upload.
acceptance: Preview can run multiple times with distinct edit records
Only delete-range changes are accepted
audio_b, edited_delay_cuts, and pause_cuts_on_original are persisted
features.owner_notes: Finalize must later read only the last successful preview.

features.title: Finalize Stage Scheduling And Result Upload
features.goal: Schedule finalize, upload final outputs, and handle GroundTruth persistence and failure split.
acceptance: Finalize reads finalize_source_edit_id from the last successful preview
final_video is uploaded and task returns success only after upload succeeds
GroundTruth upload result is stored independently from final video success
features.owner_notes: Must support original and vertical_1080p output modes.

features.title: Worker Runtime And Heartbeat Loop
features.goal: Turn the current worker image from manual test container into a scheduler-connected runtime.
acceptance: Worker registers supported task types and heartbeat
Worker loops over assigned scheduler tasks and updates device states
Worker can release after each stage and later stages may switch to a new worker

features.title: Fake TOS Integration Layer
features.goal: Provide a host-mounted Fake TOS integration environment for high-frequency scheduler regression.
acceptance: Fake TOS root is /Volumes/XIAOMA-A-1T/docker_hub/FakeTos and mounted as /fake-tos
Fake TOS scripts can prepare a run_id namespace and clean it afterward
Fake TOS tests verify object flow and cleanup without relying on real cloud TOS
features.owner_notes: Cleanup is mandatory after each run.

features.title: Automated Regression Coverage
features.goal: Add automated regression tests for Smart Cut scheduler rules, API flows, and Fake TOS integration.
acceptance: Auto-layer tests cover stage creation, illegal input, duplicate stage submission, and worker release
Fake TOS integration tests cover key binding, upload flow, and persisted artifacts
Harness smoke-test can execute the automated layer
features.owner_notes: Must map to the release gate case catalog.

features.title: Real-Data Release Gate And Cleanup
features.goal: Build the real-data release gate workflow and cleanup procedure for launch approval.
acceptance: run_release_gate.py supports real_tos mode and writes a report template instance
Real-data runs reference the execution record form and require P0/P1 pass
Cleanup scripts remove Fake TOS run data and worker local task data after test completion
features.owner_notes: Uses the real acceptance checklist and execution record files under doc/cujiian/粗剪的调度的测试.
